title: Ocean cliff waves
prompt_en: 16:9 aerial drone shot. Turquoise waves crash against dark rocky cliffs, white foam spreading. Drone slowly flies along the coastline. Overcast soft light, dramatic and fresh.
prompt_zh: 16:9 无人机航拍。碧绿海浪拍打黑色岩石悬崖，白色泡沫散开。无人机沿海岸线缓慢飞行。阴天柔光，壮观而清新。
why_it_works: Aerial + linear path is one of the most stable landscape setups for video models.
